notes.title: "Fusing Noracam" released
notes.content:
The sequel to this game, "Fusing Noracam", has been released.
Climb the mysterious tower using the new actions, wall jump and transformation!!
Plus, you can connect to the internet and climb with anyone in the world.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2598110

notes.title: Stuck fixed
notes.content:
Fixed the stuck which happened sometimes.
Sorry for leaving this issue for so long

notes.title: Update and Apologies
notes.content:
Once you beat the game in Normal mode, you can now show the timer
And, the difficulty of a certain part has been adjusted

I personally thought that part was the most fun, but now, I think it was not what the players expected from this game
I made this choice because I want to meet the demands of more players

I am very sorry to the people who have won this game in the previous version
The previous ranking will remain intact, please forgive me

notes.title: Apologies and Error Fixes
notes.content:
When this game was played on a PC monitor with a refresh rate other than 144Hz, it behaved differently than expected, making it much more difficult, and in some cases impossible

I was careful to make the game, that it does not change the behavior depending on the computer, but it has not worked
I deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused

Now it is fixed. I will be careful not to do this again in the future

*Please note: May be reset or deleted without notice
